summary: Build digital executive support skills in hybrid coordination, records workflows, and dashboards. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Next-Generation Executive Support training builds practical digital, data and hybrid workplace skills for executive assistants and office administrators. You will learn to structure Microsoft 365 workspaces, coordinate hybrid teams, manage digital records using ISO 15489 principles, create basic Excel and Power BI reporting, and clarify ownership with RACI and workflow maps. The course turns scattered information and disconnected office tools into a more reliable support system. Through practical activities, you will create SharePoint structures, Teams coordination routines, dashboards, records workflows, and meeting action registers while applying data quality controls and human-reviewed AI-assisted meeting outputs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate people, information, meetings, projects, and executive priorities through digital workplace tools. It suits beginner to intermediate users who can perform routine administrative work and now need to manage hybrid coordination, records workflows, and basic data reporting.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have practical experience in administrative, executive support, office coordination, or project support work and basic familiarity with email, calendars, spreadsheets, and shared files. Bring examples of non-confidential workflows or reporting challenges if available. Advanced Power BI development, SharePoint administration, and enterprise automation are introduced at an operational level, not taught as technical implementation disciplines.
